description: Submit one URL or a list of them to p0dcasters. A site URL works as well as a feed URL: the feed is discovered from the page. Anyone may submit; there is no account and no review queue. One URL resolves in the call and the answer carries its page; a list may be queued, and the answer says which. Rate limited per caller. Requires email: where the reviewer's decision is sent, once per submission.

email.description: Contact address; we email it when a person lists (or declines) the show.

urls.description: Podcast or site URLs. One is fine.

name: submit_feed
title: Add a podcast to p0dcasters
